method: box 40x30x20 with its top front edge (y=0, z=20) rounded at a radius running straight from 2 (x=0) to 5 (x=40). The round is the union of the balls rolled along the edge, ball s touching both faces at r(s), the law continued past the edge's ends along its end slopes: each section loses the corner points no ball reaches, up to rho(x, t), the nearest entry into a ball along the ray from the edge at the angle t. V, moments and areas integrated by Gauss-Legendre panels in x and t (tools/oracle-analytic/cases_fillets.py)
